notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with power 4 or greater that can be cast for {0} due to Animar.
You control at least one nonartifact creature token.
description:
Cast the creature by paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, as well as Cloudstone Curio if the creature isn't an artifact.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, if applicable, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Life Finds A Way trigger, creating a copy of a nonartifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the creature cast in step 1 to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
